# Owen Liu

> Stanford researcher (SAIL) working on data and evals: agent evaluation, decision models, and representation learning for clinical data. Before Stanford, co-founded TATA Technology (a marketplace that matched 20,000+ families of autistic children with trained providers).

## Community and Education

Teaching College and High School Student Researchers from Stanford University.

- [Community and Education — all paper notes, English / 中文](https://owenyliu.github.io/community/): Plain-language reads on real papers for college and high school student researchers, with an English/Chinese toggle.
- [Teach AI One Fact. Can It Guess the Rest?](https://owenyliu.github.io/readings/latent-taxonomies/): A 2-minute read on Sobotka et al. (EPFL & AXA, arXiv:2610.15836) in Chinese and English posters. 一篇论文，让我们如何写更好的论文？ Markdown: https://owenyliu.github.io/readings/md/latent-taxonomies.md

## Readings (notes, agent-readable Markdown)

- [Teach AI One Fact. Can It Guess the Rest?](https://owenyliu.github.io/readings/md/latent-taxonomies.md): Sobotka et al. on latent taxonomies — bigger AIs reason less at a fixed data budget.
- [Language Agents: From Next-Token Prediction to Digital Automation](https://owenyliu.github.io/readings/md/language-agents.md): Reading notes on Shunyu Yao's Princeton PhD dissertation (May 2024, advisor Karthik Narasimhan): WebShop, InterCode, ReAct, Tree of Thoughts, and CoALA.
- [SWE-chat: Tracing One Full Session](https://owenyliu.github.io/readings/md/swe-chat.md): A walk-through of real coding-agent sessions from the SWE-chat dataset — where the agent drifts, and what pushback looks like.
- [Medical MythTriage: Can a Fast Decision Model Be Trusted to Pre-Screen Medical Claims?](https://owenyliu.github.io/readings/md/mythtriage.md): My CS329Z midway report: a fast model settles medical claims only when it is at least 95% precise — on HealthFC it is, on MEDFACT it is not.
- [Ricursive Intelligence: A Research Pack (and a Name Trap)](https://owenyliu.github.io/readings/md/ricursive.md): Notes on Anna Goldie and Azalia Mirhoseini’s AI chip-design company — and why it is not Richard Socher’s Recursive Superintelligence.
- [Evaluating Numerical Preprocessing for Tabular Representation Learning — Findings](https://owenyliu.github.io/readings/md/cs197-findings.md): CS197 Project 3 findings (with Max Lee and Rita Xiang): the standardized baseline is genuinely good, and prediction and fidelity dissociate.
- [Calibration Benchmark — Reading Notes](https://owenyliu.github.io/readings/md/calibration-benchmark.md): What would a good benchmark for agent calibration look like? Non-toy tasks, memory, and confidence that matches reality.
- [COLM 2026 Workshop Papers, Explained](https://owenyliu.github.io/readings/md/colm-2026.md): Plain-English explainers of 11 Stanford and 4 Berkeley papers from the COLM 2026 workshops.
